title: M2c editorial generated-scene acoustic baseline
summary: Editorial persistent baseline uses contract scale 0..2, not physical decibels. 0 is no persistent masking penalty, not a claim of silence. Moving river channels and exposed estuary families use 1 for ordinary persistent water masking. Backwaters and other families use 0. Weather, transient water events, human activity and animal calls are runtime events/modifiers and must not overwrite this baseline. No family is assigned persistent level 2 without stronger local evidence.
limitations: The family tuple and scene/G6 identities are copied from the exact expansion catalog; landscape/land-use/scene applicability retain the directness and confidence recorded in authoring-evidence.json. Numeric ambient values are explicit low-confidence analogical authoring judgments, never historical measurements.

title: M2c canonical terminal editorial acoustic baseline
summary: For each exact canonical terminal G5/scene/G6 slot reached by the 86 approved directional exits, copy the persistent acoustic scale value of its exact G4 generated-family profiles. All families within each G4 agree. This is a new low-confidence editorial applicability judgment for the canonical scene, not automatic inheritance or a historical measurement. Values 0 and 1 retain the independently approved family policy: 0 means no persistent masking penalty, not silence; 1 ordinary moving-water masking. Temporary events and weather remain separate; no level 2 is authored.
limitations: Exact canonical G5, source profile, scene and slot identities are direct catalog copies. Landscape/land-use/function classifications keep the evidence directness and confidence below. Numeric values and their applicability to canonical endpoints are analogical/low editorial authoring, requiring this separate approval.
